added.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Job Family Definition:

Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.

Management Level Definition

Contributes to assignments of limited scope by applying technical concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education, or previous experience. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.

Responsibilities

Codes and programs enhancements, updates, and changes for portions and subsystems of systems software, including operating systems, compliers, networking, utilities, databases, and Internet-related tools
Executes established test plans and protocols for assigned portions of code; identifies, logs, and debugs assigned issues.
Develops understanding of and relationship with internal and outsourced development partners on software systems design and development.
Participates as a member of project team of other software systems engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for low to moderately- complex products.

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
Typically 0-2 years experience

Knowledge And Skills

Strong programming fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, GoLang.
Understanding of operating systems (Linux) and computer networking concepts.
Experience in various test methodologies white box, black box, solution testing is desirable.
Understanding of L2/L3 protocols such as TCP/IP protocol suite, Ethernet switching
Routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP, IS-IS, Multicast, MPLS, RSVP, L2VPN, L3VPN, VPLS.. etc.)
FreeBSD/LINUX/VM environments
Be a fast learner, proactive and able to handle multiple tasks efficiently while adopting to existing and newer technologies
Must possess outstanding problem solving skills
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

Outstanding problem-solving skills in the diagnosis and resolution of customer issues.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

added.title: Systems Software Engineer
added.description:
This position supports the 40 FLTS at Eglin AFB, FL in support of developmental ground and flight test operations, with primary emphasis on systems software engineering, software configuration management, software development, software testing, and software integration supporting the VENOM flight test program. Provides advice and assistance with software configuration management activities, to include the development, implementation, maintenance, and improvement of software configuration control procedures, baselines, version control practices, change tracking, release management, and configuration status accounting. Supports preparation, review, and editing of test documentation, reports, plans, briefing materials, and other technical products associated with software and system integration activities. Assesses software performance during ground and flight test events and provides technical recommendations regarding deficiencies, anomalies, corrective actions, and follow-on test requirements. Maintains awareness of security guidance and applicable USAF policies affecting software development, software integration, configuration management, test execution, and data handling, and shall provide recommendations to maintain compliance with Government-directed requirements. Provide advice and assistance with software integration activities to ensure software, hardware, instrumentation, and mission systems operate together to support developmental test objectives. This skill level typically performs all functional duties independently.

Qualifications

Software Development

Design, implement, debug, and maintain production-quality software in Python and modern C/C++, with opportunities to work in TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Bash, SQL, Lua, and other languages where appropriate.
Strong production experience in at least two programming languages, including either Python or modern C++.
Working ability to contribute in both Python and C/C++, or demonstrated experience rapidly becoming effective across comparable high-level and systems languages.
Solid knowledge of algorithms, data structures, object-oriented and functional design principles, concurrency, networking, error handling, logging, and API design.
Experience developing on Linux and using Git-based collaborative workflows.
Practical experience deploying or operating containerized workloads with Kubernetes or RKE2, including manifests, pods, services, configuration and secrets, persistent storage, health/readiness checks, logs, upgrades, and failure diagnosis.
Ability to make local Docker/Podman Compose workflows and deployed RKE2 environments reproducible and operationally consistent across developer, CI, laboratory, test, and disconnected systems.
Experience creating or maintaining CI/CD pipelines that build, test, scan, package, sign or checksum, publish, deploy, and promote reproducible artifacts.

LANGUAGES

Advanced Python, including type hints, asynchronous programming, packaging, virtual environments, Poetry or uv, pytest, Pydantic, NumPy, pandas, Cython, Ruff/Black, and mypy.
Modern C++ (C++17 or later), CMake, GCC/Clang, GoogleTest, code coverage, sanitizers, Valgrind, cppcheck, clang-format, shared/static libraries, ABI concerns, and Python bindings such as pybind11 or Cython.
TypeScript/JavaScript with Node.js, Express, WebSockets, React, Vite, Vitest/Jest, ESLint/Prettier, runtime validation such as Zod, and monorepo/package-workspace practices.
Bash and Linux systems scripting; Make, RPM/spec-file packaging, systemd, firewalld, SELinux, and network configuration.
Protocol Buffers and generated multi-language APIs, including schema evolution and compatibility testing. Required.

Desired Experience

Experience working with operational or developmental test organizations.
Recent and relevant experience with fighter aircraft systems, software integration, and developmental test processes sufficient to provide effective support to 40 FLTS mission requirements.
Active TS/SCI clearance.
Master's degree.

added.title: Software Engineer III - Cloud Security - FCS Workflow (Hybrid)
added.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike Cloud Workload Protection places security controls at the level of individual application workloads. It enables organizations to identify and remediate vulnerabilities across the application lifecycle, enforcing compliance and security best practices across containers, Kubernetes and any workload. We also build security tools into the earliest phases of the development process, so vulnerable code is identified as it is written rather than in testing, which reduces costs and results in more secure applications.

Our engineers work with AI coding agents every day. We're looking for people who can use these tools to move fast while bringing the judgment, depth and ownership that keep production systems correct and secure.

This role is hybrid, requiring a minimum of 3 days per week on-site from our New York City office.

What You’ll Do:

Contribute to and lead backend engineering efforts, from rapid prototypes to large-scale services across CrowdStrike's cloud security products.
Design, build, test, deploy and operate large-scale distributed services. Use AI coding agents to speed up delivery, while staying fully accountable for the correctness, security and maintainability of everything you ship.
Turn product requirements into clear technical designs and well-scoped tasks that both engineers and AI agents can carry out reliably.
Review code with a critical eye, whether a person or an agent wrote it. Catch logic errors, performance problems, insecure patterns and unnecessary complexity.
Build and maintain the guardrails that make fast, AI-assisted development safe: strong test suites, CI checks, static analysis, observability and clear repository documentation and conventions.
Triage and debug production issues across distributed systems, using AI tools to speed up investigation while applying your own judgment about root cause and impact.
Build public-facing command-line tools, some of which interact with our web services.
Mentor other engineers on our services, engineering best practices, and effective and responsible use of AI development tools.
Work with cross-functional teams across geographies, and partner with Product to define requirements and deliver features.
Respond to customer-reported issues quickly and take ownership through to resolution.
Keep re-evaluating our architecture, test coverage, performance, observability and stability, including how our team's development workflows can improve as AI tooling evolves.
Ultimately, help build a platform that secures the entire lifecycle of cloud workloads for CrowdStrike customers.

What You’ll Need:

U.S. citizen or Permanent Resident and work solely from U.S. soil.
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
A solid understanding of distributed systems and scalability challenges. Sharding, partitioning and horizontal scaling are second nature to you.
Strong programming fundamentals in at least one statically typed language. We write Go; you can learn it on the job, but you should be able to read and judge Go code critically.
Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep), and Docker/Kubernetes/Helm.
Experience with Kafka or a similar message queue (message design, sizing and rates, monitoring consumer lag) and with relational databases such as Postgres.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Experience with, or strong interest in, AI-assisted development. You know how to give an agent the right context, when to trust its output, and when to step in and write or rewrite the code yourself.
Awareness of the risks that come with AI-generated code: invented or untrusted dependencies, secrets exposure, prompt injection, and insecure defaults.
Excellent code review skills, and a strong grasp of testing strategies that make correctness checkable rather than assumed.
Clear written communication. Design docs, task breakdowns and pull request descriptions are how you guide both your teammates and your tools.
A habit of owning outcomes: you meet commitments, you love seeing your code run in production, and you stand behind it when it breaks.

Bonus Points:

Understanding of cloud security concepts such as CSPM, CWPP and CNAPP.
Familiarity with container and Kubernetes security (build-time and runtime).
Exposure to cloud security products, including product direction for AI/ML, XDR, SIEM, SOAR or related cybersecurity domains.
Experience building internal developer tooling or agent integrations, such as tool/MCP servers or automated review and remediation pipelines.
Experience securing AI/LLM-powered systems, or applying AI to cloud security detection and remediation.
Experience with large-scale data processing like Apache and Spark and analytical queries like Apache Pinot

This role will require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass additional background and fingerprint check(s) consistent with government customer requirements.

added.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown
is seeking a Cloud Platform Engineer
to join our growing team in Plano, TX!

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to help build, automate, support, and scale enterprise Azure cloud services. This role will contribute to cloud platform engineering, infrastructure automation, operational excellence, and standardized cloud service delivery across the organization. The ideal candidate has strong Azure engineering experience and is passionate about Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, cloud operations, and platform standardization. This engineer will work closely with cloud architects, application teams, security, networking, and operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions.

This role combines cloud engineering, operational support, automation, and continuous improvement responsibilities within a modern cloud platform environment.

Core Platform Engineering

Design, build, deploy, and support Azure cloud infrastructure services across compute, networking, identity, storage, and security domains.
Contribute to the design and ongoing evolution of enterprise Azure cloud platform capabilities.
Develop and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules using Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or similar technologies.

Integrate cloud solutions into existing enterprise infrastructure while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
Produce technical designs, deployment documentation, operational procedures, and engineering standards.

Cloud Automation & DevOps Enablement

Automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational tasks using PowerShell, scripting, Azure Automation, and DevOps tooling.
Support adoption of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and cloud engineering best practices across technology teams.
Contribute to development of standardized cloud platform services, golden paths, and deployment templates.
Collaborate with architects and development teams to implement automated, repeatable, and governed cloud solutions.
Promote platform engineering principles focused on standardization, automation, self-service, and operational maturity.
